intro.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function to find the smallest number in a rotated sorted array. You will learn how to apply binary search, a core algorithm for efficiently searching in sorted data, to solve this problem. The main constructs involved are arrays, loops, and conditional logic in JavaScript. By the end, you'll understand how to adapt binary search for arrays that have been rotated, a common scenario in algorithm challenges.
intro.usecase: Finding the minimum in a rotated sorted array is a fundamental pattern used in systems that process time-series data or sorted datasets that may have been shifted. For example, in financial dashboards displaying stock prices over time, this algorithm helps identify the lowest price point after market hours when the data might be rotated. It's also essential in calendar applications that need to find the earliest available appointment slot in a rotated schedule, or in e-commerce filters that must locate the minimum price in a sorted product list that's been circularly shifted. Understanding this pattern enables developers to efficiently handle sorted data that arrives in non-standard orientations.
